package rulefixtures

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
	"time"
)

// scenario for connection_pool_reconfigured_per_request: DB pool sizing or lifetime settings changed on request paths.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.
type Rule249PositiveHandler struct {
	db *sql.DB
}

func (h *Rule249PositiveHandler) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	h.db.SetMaxOpenConns(50)
	h.db.SetMaxIdleConns(10)
	h.db.SetConnMaxLifetime(30 * time.Second)

	rows, err := h.db.QueryContext(r.Context(), "SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE active = 1")
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	w.Write([]byte(`{"status":"ok"}`))
}
